# Fly.io Free Plan

> Learn how the Fly.io Free plan works: $1 of credit to start, $5 of usage every month once you add a card, its limits, what happens when credit runs out, and how to upgrade.

Every new Fly.io account starts on the Free plan. You get $1 of credit with no credit card, and $5 of usage every month once you add a card. This page explains what it covers, its limits, and what happens when you use it up.

## How the Free plan works

The Free plan is for your personal organization, the one we create when you sign up. It doesn't expire.

- Without a credit card: you get $1 of credit when you create your account. It's a one-time credit, and it expires after 7 days.
- With a credit card: you get $5 of usage every month.

Adding a card doesn't move you to Pay As You Go. Your organization stays on the Free plan, with the same limits. Moving to Pay As You Go is a separate plan change that you choose. See Upgrade to Pay As You Go.

## What the credit covers

The $1 credit and the monthly $5 cover:

- Machines
- Volumes and volume snapshots
- Data transfer
- Sprites
- One Managed Postgres cluster on the $4 Developer plan

With a card, you get the full $5 in your first month, and a new $5 on the 1st of every month. Any of your $1 credit that's left is used first. New Free organizations with a card also get the $30 Sprites credit, which is used before the $5.

Each card can be on only one organization's Free plan.

## Free plan limits

- Members: 1. You can't invite other members.
- Machines: up to 3, with no performance Machines.
- Volumes: up to 5GB each.
- Sprites: up to 3.
- Managed Postgres: 1 cluster, on the Developer plan.
- Support: community support.

These limits are the same with or without a card.

> [!TIP]
> 
> `fly deploy` creates 2 Machines per app by default. Use `fly deploy --ha=false` to run 1 Machine per app, so you can run up to 3 apps.

These aren't available on the Free plan:

- Managed Postgres plans other than Developer
- Extensions such as Tigris, Supabase and Upstash Redis
- Dedicated IPv4 addresses and static egress IP addresses
- Linked organizations

To use any of these, upgrade to Pay As You Go.

## Switch to the Free plan

If your personal organization is already on Pay As You Go, you can switch to the Free plan from the Billing page in the dashboard. Your organization can't have anything the Free plan doesn't include, such as a Managed Postgres cluster on a plan other than Developer, a volume larger than 5GB, an extension, or other members. Remove them first, then switch.

## When the $1 credit runs out

When the $1 is used up, or after 7 days, you can't create new resources, and we email you to let you know.

To keep going, add a credit card to get $5 of usage every month.

## When the $5 runs out

We email you when you have $1 or less of the month's $5 left.

When you use up the $5, your organization moves to Pay As You Go automatically, so nothing stops. The month's $5 is removed, and the whole month's usage is billed at standard rates from the first cent, not just the usage above $5. The Free plan limits are lifted.

If you stay on the Free plan, you get a new $5 on the 1st.

## Upgrade to Pay As You Go

You can upgrade to Pay As You Go at any time from the Billing page in the dashboard. The Free plan limits are lifted right away.

When you upgrade, Pay As You Go bills the whole month from the first cent, including the usage the $5 covered so far. For prices, see Fly.io Resource Pricing.

## Check your usage

You can see how much of the month's $5 you've used on the Billing page in the dashboard.

## FAQ

### Does Fly.io have a free tier?

Yes. Every new account starts on the Free plan, with $1 of credit and no credit card needed. Add a card to get $5 of usage every month.

### Do I need a credit card for the Free plan?

No. Without a card, you get a one-time $1 of credit that lasts 7 days. With a card, you get $5 of usage every month. Adding a card keeps you on the Free plan.

### Can I put other organizations on the Free plan?

No. Only your personal organization can be on the Free plan. Other organizations use Pay As You Go.

### Can I use Managed Postgres on the Free plan?

Yes. You can have one cluster on the Developer plan, which costs $4 a month and counts toward your $5. To move it to a larger plan, or to create more clusters, upgrade to Pay As You Go first.

### Will I be charged on the Free plan?

Not while your organization stays within the $5. If your usage goes over $5, your organization moves to Pay As You Go, and the whole month is billed at standard rates.

### Why is the whole month billed when I move to Pay As You Go?

The $5 is a free allowance for the Free plan, with its limits. Pay As You Go removes those limits and bills all usage at standard rates, without the $5. When you move, the whole month is billed on Pay As You Go, whether you upgrade yourself or go over $5. To keep costs down, watch your usage on the Billing page. See Cost Management.

### Do Free plan organizations get the under-$5 waiver?

No. The Free plan replaces the waiver for new organizations.

---

## Related Reading

- Fly.io Resource Pricing
- How Billing Works
- Cost Management

# Fly.io pricing

Compute bills by the second, storage on what you provision. Two account
plans: Free, with $5 of usage every month, and Pay As You Go. Managed
Postgres is sized by cluster plan.

Canonical page: https://fly.io/pricing/
Sign up: https://fly.io/app/sign-up/

Start on the Free plan with $1 of starter credit, no credit card required. Add a card to keep going when it is used up or expires. The
Free plan gives $5 of usage every month after you add a card.

Prices in USD, excluding tax. Compute prices are for Ashburn (iad); other
regions vary — see https://docs.fly.io/reference/regions.

## Plans

### Plan — Free, $0 / mo

Small projects, free every month.

- $5 of usage, every month
- Up to 3 Machines and 3 Sprites
- 1 user
- A Developer Managed Postgres database, paid from the $5
- At $5, you move to Pay As You Go and keep running
- Community support

Credit card required. The $5 covers Machines, Sprites, volumes, bandwidth and networking, and a Developer Managed Postgres database. Partner databases and extensions aren't available on Free.

Sign up: https://fly.io/app/sign-up/?plan=free

### Plan — Pay As You Go, $0 / mo + usage

From first sandbox to production, on one plan.

- Everything in Free, with no caps on compute or spend
- Invite your whole team
- Partner databases and extensions
- Email support, additional support available for purchase
- No minimum spend

Usage is billed monthly. Cancel anytime.

Sign up: https://fly.io/app/sign-up/?plan=payg

## Machines

Billed by the second while a Machine runs.

### Machines — compute

Every preset takes more RAM at $6.00 per GB per month, up to 128GB.

| Preset | Per hour | Per month |
| --- | --- | --- |
| shared-cpu-1x · 256MB | $0.0030 | $2.19 |
| shared-cpu-2x · 512MB | $0.0061 | $4.39 |
| shared-cpu-4x · 1GB | $0.0122 | $8.78 |
| shared-cpu-6x · 1.5GB | $0.0183 | $13.16 |
| shared-cpu-8x · 2GB | $0.0244 | $17.55 |
| performance-1x · 2GB | $0.0458 | $33.00 |
| performance-2x · 4GB | $0.0917 | $66.00 |
| performance-4x · 8GB | $0.1833 | $132.01 |
| performance-6x · 12GB | $0.2750 | $198.01 |
| performance-8x · 16GB | $0.3667 | $264.01 |
| performance-10x · 20GB | $0.4584 | $330.01 |
| performance-12x · 24GB | $0.5500 | $396.02 |
| performance-14x · 28GB | $0.6417 | $462.02 |
| performance-16x · 32GB | $0.7334 | $528.02 |
| Stopped Machine, per GB rootfs | — | $0.15 |

### Machines — compute by region

A region's price is the Ashburn price above times its multiplier, applied
to vCPU and RAM. Volumes and snapshots do not take this markup, and egress
is priced by destination rather than by the Machine's region.

| Region | Code | Multiplier | shared-cpu-1x · 256MB | performance-1x · 2GB |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Secaucus, NJ (US) | ewr | 1.000 | $2.19 | $33.00 |
| Ashburn, Virginia (US) | iad | 1.000 | $2.19 | $33.00 |
| Amsterdam, Netherlands | ams | 1.038 | $2.28 | $34.27 |
| Stockholm, Sweden | arn | 1.038 | $2.28 | $34.27 |
| Toronto, Canada | yyz | 1.115 | $2.45 | $36.81 |
| Paris, France | cdg | 1.135 | $2.49 | $37.44 |
| London, United Kingdom | lhr | 1.135 | $2.49 | $37.44 |
| Frankfurt, Germany | fra | 1.154 | $2.53 | $38.08 |
| San Jose, California (US) | sjc | 1.192 | $2.62 | $39.35 |
| Los Angeles, California (US) | lax | 1.200 | $2.63 | $39.59 |
| Dallas, Texas (US) | dfw | 1.250 | $2.74 | $41.25 |
| Chicago, Illinois (US) | ord | 1.250 | $2.74 | $41.25 |
| Singapore, Singapore | sin | 1.269 | $2.78 | $41.89 |
| Sydney, Australia | syd | 1.269 | $2.78 | $41.89 |
| Johannesburg, South Africa | jnb | 1.303 | $2.86 | $43.00 |
| Tokyo, Japan | nrt | 1.308 | $2.87 | $43.16 |
| São Paulo, Brazil | gru | 1.615 | $3.54 | $53.31 |

### Machines — storage and network

Volumes bill on provisioned capacity, not usage. First 10GB of snapshots
free each month. Every app gets a shared IPv4 and unlimited Anycast IPv6.

| Item | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Volumes, per GB / month | $0.15 |
| Snapshots, per GB / month | $0.08 |
| Egress, North America and Europe | $0.02 / GB |
| Egress, Asia Pacific, Oceania and South America | $0.04 / GB |
| Egress, Africa and India | $0.12 / GB |
| Dedicated IPv4 | $2.00 / mo |

### Machines — reserved compute

Reserve compute and save 30%. One-year blocks from $42/yr for shared,
$168/yr for performance. See
https://docs.fly.io/about/pricing#machine-reservation-blocks.

### Global CPU/RAM reservations

Commit for twelve months across all regions and Machine classes. Save 20%
with upfront payment or 10% with monthly payment. Credits expire monthly and
apply only to CPU/RAM, after region/class reservations. Existing purchases
retain their original terms. Choose any whole-dollar monthly credit
from $100 to $50,000; the table shows examples. For
more, contact billing@fly.io.

| Monthly CPU/RAM credit | Upfront payment (20% off) | Monthly payment for 12 months (10% off) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $100.00 | $960.00 | $90.00 |
| $500.00 | $4800.00 | $450.00 |
| $1000.00 | $9600.00 | $900.00 |

https://docs.fly.io/about/pricing#global-cpuram-reservations.

## Sprites

CPU, memory and hot storage are metered per hour of active use; a Sprite
that exists but does nothing costs nothing beyond its stored data.

### Sprites — compute

| Resource | Detail | Rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CPU time | Cumulative CPU usage measured by cpu.stat | $0.0385 / CPU-hour |
| Memory time | Actual memory usage | $0.021875 / GB-hour |

### Sprites — storage

Storage bills in GB-hours at two rates. Hot storage stops billing when the
Sprite goes to sleep; cold storage bills for as long as the data exists, so
a Sprite that is asleep all month still accrues it. Per-month figures are
the hourly rate over a 730-hour month.

| Tier | When it bills | Rate | Per GB-month |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hot | Bills while the Sprite is awake | $0.000683 / GB-hour | $0.50 |
| Cold | Bills for as long as you keep it | $0.000027 / GB-hour | $0.02 |

Estimate a workload at https://fly.io/calculator/.

## Managed Postgres

### Managed Postgres — cluster plans

Every plan includes high availability and automated backups. Basic and up
add connection pooling and point-in-time restore. Developer includes its
storage, up to 5GB, and pauses after 15 minutes without a client.

| Plan | CPU and RAM | Per month |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Developer | shared-1x · 256MB | $4 |
| Basic | shared-2x · 1GB | $38 |
| Starter | shared-2x · 2GB | $72 |
| Launch | performance-2x · 8GB | $282 |
| Scale | performance-4x · 32GB | $962 |
| Performance | performance-8x · 64GB | $1,922 |

### Managed Postgres — Developer plan

For agents, side projects and small apps, $4 per month.

- Two shared-1x 256MB members with failover
- 1GB of storage at create, up to 5GB, included in the price
- Clients connect straight to Postgres through fly-proxy, with no PgBouncer
- A full backup every day, without point-in-time restore
- Pauses after 15 minutes without a client and wakes on the next connection
- On the Free plan, 1 Developer cluster per org, paid from the $5 of monthly usage

### Managed Postgres — storage

Billed on the storage your databases use, for a 30-day month, metered
hourly. Creating or deleting a cluster mid-month is prorated. Same-region
transfer is free.

| Item | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Database storage, per GB | $0.28 |
| Example: 10GB used | $2.80 / mo |
| Maximum per cluster | 1,000 GB |

## Support

Community support is free and always has been. The paid plans add an easily
nerd-sniped support team that feels like an extension of your own.

### Support — Standard, $29 / mo

Basic support for single developers and small teams. Great for personal projects and startups.

- 36-hour first response time
- Technical architecture support

### Support — Premium, $199 / mo

Enhanced support for growing businesses. Ideal for scaling applications and teams.

- 24-hour first response time
- 1-hour first response for urgent issues
- Dedicated Slack support channel
- Quarterly Solutions Architecture sessions

### Support — Enterprise, From $2,500 / mo

Top-tier support for large-scale operations. Perfect for mission-critical apps and enterprise deployments.

- 4-hour first response time, 24x7
- 15-minute emergency first response, 24x7
- Dedicated Slack support channel
- Quarterly Solutions Architecture sessions
- 99.9% uptime SLA

## Compliance

HIPAA at no extra cost, with the BAA pre-signed. The BAA and the SOC 2
report (under NDA) are in the Trust Center of your dashboard on every
plan. See https://fly.io/compliance/.

- SOC 2 Type II
- DPA available
- BAA pre-signed

## Prepaid credit with MPP

Agents can load credit into an org with MPP, the Machine Payments Protocol
(https://mpp.dev). We recommend paying with `link-cli`: POST
`{"org_slug": "personal", "amount": "25"}` to
https://fly.io/api/v1/mpp/credits with a Fly API token for that org,
pay the 402 challenge with `link-cli mpp pay`, and the human approves the
payment in the Link app. Amounts are 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 USD. Full steps
are at https://fly.io
